definitions.full: H1716. dagar [ דָּגַר ] verb gather together as a brood (compare Aramaic דְּגַר heap together ; so Nasar.) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular דָּ֨גָר Jer 17:11 ; 3 feminine singular דָּֽגְרָה Isa 34:15 — gather together into its shadow 34:15 (of קִמֹּז , q. v.), יָלָד֑ וְלֹא דָּגָר Jer 17:11 (of partridge; simile of one getting riches unjustly).
